This was a great ad guys ! I went out of my way to find it just to show my friends and give you guys positive feedback ! Here’s what I liked about it compared to advertisements in general these days, 
-it was concise
-it was not upsetting (which is surprisingly rare for ads these days) 
-it was funny and entertaining
-it introduced me to a fun and creative new idea of making a log cabin version of a gingerbread house  
-it enriched my life instead of wasting my time 
-didn’t feel scammy or misleading (another surprisingly rare occurrence in ads these days)
-felt like you guys put a lot of creativity and effort into it for just selling us a simple product and you had fun with it 
-the product is affordable and attainable for basically everyone so we can all easily enjoy the idea being presented  

10/10 I will spend like 4 of my hard earned dollars on a bag of pretzels <3
